prediction_text: Both things asked will in substance come to pass, but slowly and with limited profit: (1) the King will procure some forces/aid out of Ireland, though they come slowly and do the Parliament less harm than feared; (2) the Queen will advance from the North and meet the King — the meeting perfects — but her own fortune declines as she comes (her significator passing into his fall), so she prospers little by it. (Here 'positive' = the procurement and the meeting occur.)
timing: Month scale: the Moon wants three or four degrees of the trine of Saturn (the Queen's significatrix) — the meeting in about three to four months; the Irish aid is slower, the Sun wanting six degrees of the cusp of the 11th — about six units (months) and imperfect/partile never quite attained, hence aid partial.
basis: Lilly: his Majesty is signified by the Moon in Cancer in the 10th, in her own house, increasing in light and void of all infelicity except slowness in motion — the King himself is strong, only slow; hence procurement is delayed, not denied. The Sun, lord of the 11th (assistance/aid), is in the 7th in his exaltation applying toward the cusp of the 11th but wanting six degrees of being partile, in opposition to the Ascendant (Parliament): aid is on its way and directed against Parliament, but the want of partile perfection makes it late and its harm imperfect. The Queen's significatrix Saturn removes out of one sign into Aries, his fall — she advances but into decline; the Moon wanting three or four degrees of Saturn's trine perfects the meeting within that term. Confidence lowered because aid never reaches partile perfection.
